mapper.sql: id, skill_code, name, description, category, object_key, file_name, file_size, creator_id, is_enabled AS enabled, publish_status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mcp_skill WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mcp_skill WHERE skill_code = #{skillCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mcp_skill WHERE skill_code = #{skillCode} AND is_enabled = 1 AND publish_status != 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mcp_skill WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} OR creator_id IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM mcp_skill WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND publish_status = 2 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM mcp_skill ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT skill_code FROM mcp_skill WHERE skill_code REGEXP '^SKILL[0-9]{10}$' ORDER BY skill_code DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_skill SET skill_code = #{skillCode}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, object_key = #{objectKey}, file_name = #{fileName}, file_size = #{fileSize}, creator_id = #{creatorId}, is_enabled = #{enabled}, publish_status = #{publishStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
